title: Guitar with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='42' cy='70' r='2.6' fill='#5A2E12'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='70' r='2.6' fill='#5A2E12'/>

  <circle cx='58.8' cy='69.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFE9C4'/>
